assistant:  It's completely fine to not enjoy spicy food. Everyone has different taste preferences and there's no right or wrong when it comes to personal preferences. If you don't like spicy food, you can opt for milder options or request the chef to prepare your meal without any spice. There are plenty of delicious dishes available that don't involve any heat, so you can still enjoy a wide variety of flavors and cuisines.
